validation.quality_audit: See archived prior_graph_cpu_20261102.json for 4096 accepted tables over two lengths and two seeds; not rerun after container recreation. No quality equivalence or downstream generalization guarantee is inferred from non-significant audit deltas.
limitations: First reference runs incurred cold compilation; launch wall differences are uncontrolled.
160-step windows do not establish long-term throughput or tail stability.
BF16 reference a2 train timing differs materially; input and runtime effects are not isolated.
Prior/train maxima can come from different ranks and must not be added.
No attempt was made to preserve RNG streams or bitwise floating-point output.

float32.launch_wall_caveat: Runs share compiler caches; the first run can pay cold compilation. Launch wall includes startup, compilation, warmup and shutdown. Use steady-step throughput for the ABBA performance comparison.
